Check 6 needs "npm test reports exit=0" and a test that runs bin/csv2json.js with --tsv on tab input and "asserts on the output". This matches "checks its output". Check 7 needs README.md to describe --tsv and give an example command line using it, which matches the line. The stricter items sit under "Advisory (not part of PASS or FAIL)": `npm run test:cli`, the exact `node bin/csv2json.js --tsv < file` form and wording, and the flag-position and parse.js checks. No PASS or FAIL condition goes beyond the expect line's words.
